mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour BTC close crossing outside both canonical Chande Kroll Stop lines confirms a volatility-adjusted trend breakout; follow the breakout side for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when close newly becomes strictly above both stop lines; short when close newly becomes strictly below both stop lines
mechanism.why_distinct: Chande Kroll Stop applies Wilder ATR to ten-bar extrema and then a second nine-bar extremum to two preliminary stop paths. It is not the single-stage Chandelier Exit, recursive Supertrend band, fixed channel, moving-average crossover, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the dual stop distance scales with causal true range and the completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour dual-stop exterior crossings are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.atr: Wilder ATR(10), seeded by the simple mean of the first ten true ranges then recursively updated with alpha=1/10
features.preliminary_stops: highest high over ten bars minus ATR, and lowest low over ten bars plus ATR
features.final_stops: nine-bar rolling maximum of preliminary high stop and nine-bar rolling minimum of preliminary low stop
features.event: current close newly strictly above both final stops from not above both, or newly strictly below both from not below both
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Chande Kroll Stop(10,1,9) dual-line breakout under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no ATR/stop period, multiplier, smoothing, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Tushar Chande and Stanley Kroll; QuantConnect LEAN canonical implementation and TradingView interpretation
external_basis.fixed_definition: parameters 10,1,9; Wilder ATR(10); highStop=highestHigh(10)-ATR; lowStop=lowestLow(10)+ATR; ShortStop=highest(highStop,9); LongStop=lowest(lowStop,9); warmup 18 bars
external_basis.selection_use: published parameters, Wilder smoothing, two-stage stops, and close outside both lines direction only; no incidence or outcomes
